{"slug": "kodely-vs-wix", "title": "Kodely vs Wix: Which AI Builder Should You Use? (2026)", "metaTitle": "Kodely vs Wix: Which AI Builder Should You Use? (2026)", "metaDescription": "Kodely and Wix both promise a fast path to a live website, but they solve different problems. Here is an honest, feature-by-feature comparison for 2026.", "targetKeyword": "kodely vs wix", "category": "Comparisons", "bodyHtml": "

Wix and Kodely both let you go from idea to live website fast, but they are built on almost opposite philosophies. Wix gives you a mature drag-and-drop editor, an AI-assisted onboarding flow called Wix ADI, and a massive app ecosystem for e-commerce, bookings, and email marketing. Kodely gives you a chat interface that writes real React code, a live preview of the actual compiled app, and one-click publishing to a free subdomain. Neither is objectively better. This comparison lays out exactly where each one wins so you can pick the right tool for what you are building right now.

TL/DR verdict

CategoryKodelyWix
How it buildsChat-based, generates real Vite + React 19 + TypeScript + Tailwind codeDrag-and-drop editor, plus AI-assisted Wix ADI setup
Code ownershipReal, readable source files you can view and copy in-appProprietary, not exportable or portable
Pricing modelFree 750 credits, then pay-as-you-go top-ups, credits never expireRecurring monthly or annual subscription plans
HostingFree *.kodely.site subdomain, included on publishHosting included, plus custom domain support as standard
E-commerce / booking / emailNot available yetBuilt in, mature, extensive
App marketplaceNone yetLarge third-party app marketplace
Best forFast, code-real prototypes and marketing sites you want to inspect and iterate on by chattingSmall businesses that want e-commerce, bookings, and marketing tools bundled today

Pricing and the credit model

Wix runs on recurring subscription plans, priced by tier and feature set, billed monthly or annually whether you touch the editor that week or not. Kodely works differently: you get 750 free credits on signup with no credit card required, and credits are metered from the actual AI cost of each generation. Top-ups are simple and one-time: $9 for 500 credits, $40 for 2,500 credits (the most popular option), and $90 for 6,000 credits. Credits never expire, and if a generation fails to compile, Kodely attempts one automatic repair before ever charging you for it. If you want a subscription-free way to build and are comfortable paying only for what you generate, Kodely's model is more transparent. If you want every feature unlocked in one flat recurring plan, Wix's structure is more predictable long term.

Do you actually own the code

This is the sharpest difference between the two products. Wix output lives entirely inside Wix's proprietary system. There is no exportable codebase, and if you ever want to leave Wix, you are rebuilding from scratch on another platform. Kodely generates a real Vite + React 19 + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS v4 application from a hand-built foundation codebase, with genuine component files, not a page builder's internal format. You can open the in-app code view and see and copy the actual generated source files at any time. One honest limit worth naming clearly: Kodely does not yet offer a full project zip download or export, so today the code lives and is copyable inside the product, not something you can pull down as a complete portable project in one click.

Hosting and going live

Wix hosts everything for you and supports custom domains as a standard part of its plans, so yourname.com pointing at your Wix site is routine. Kodely also hosts for you, for free, but today only on a name.kodely.site subdomain. There is no separate hosting step, no extra cost, and no custom domain support yet. If a branded domain matters for your launch right now, that is a real point in Wix's favor. If a fast, free, working URL is enough to validate an idea or ship a landing page immediately, Kodely's one-click Publish gets you there in a chat message.

Backend, e-commerce, and business tools

Wix has spent years building out booking systems, email marketing, memberships, and a full e-commerce stack with payments, inventory, and shipping. It is genuinely mature in this area. Kodely, as of today, does not generate backend logic, databases, authentication, or payments at all. It builds the front-end application layer only. If your project needs to take orders, manage a customer login, or run a booking calendar this month, Wix is the more complete tool. Kodely is the better fit for the front-end itself, and for teams that will wire up their own backend or add commerce later.

App marketplace and ecosystem

Wix's App Market is one of its biggest advantages: thousands of third-party integrations for reviews, forms, chat widgets, SEO tools, and more, installable without touching code. Kodely has no app marketplace. Every change happens by describing it in chat, and Kodely edits the real components directly. That keeps things simple and code-native, but it means there is no plug-in ecosystem to lean on yet.

Security

Both platforms take publishing security seriously in different ways. Wix, as a hosted proprietary platform, manages security at the infrastructure level across its entire user base. Kodely scans every publish for accidentally leaked secrets or API keys before the site goes live, which matters specifically because Kodely-generated code is real and visible, so a stray key in a component file is a realistic risk a code-generating tool has to guard against.

Who should actually use which

Choose Wix if you need e-commerce, bookings, email marketing, a custom domain, or a large app ecosystem working out of the box today, and you are comfortable with a proprietary, non-portable editor. Choose Kodely if you want to describe a site in plain English and get back real, inspectable React code with a live preview, you are fine on a kodely.site subdomain for now, and you would rather pay per build than commit to a subscription. Many builders will outgrow Kodely's current feature set for a full commerce site; just as many will find Wix's editor and app sprawl like using a sledgehammer for a landing page.

FAQ

Is Kodely open-source or self-hostable?

No. Kodely is a hosted product, and the source it generates is viewable and copyable in-app, not exportable as a self-hostable project today.

Can I connect a custom domain on Kodely?

Not yet. Every Kodely site publishes to a free name.kodely.site subdomain. Custom domains are not supported today.

Does Kodely support e-commerce like Wix does?

No. Kodely does not currently generate backend logic, databases, or payment processing, so it cannot replicate Wix's e-commerce stack.

Which is cheaper, Kodely or Wix?

They are structured differently, so cheaper depends on usage. Wix is a recurring subscription regardless of activity. Kodely starts with 750 free credits and then charges only for what you generate, with credits that never expire.

Can I try Kodely without a credit card?

Yes. Signing up gives you 750 free credits with no credit card required, enough to test the chat-to-code workflow and publish a live site.

Ready to see the difference for yourself? Start building free on Kodely and get a real, working React app live on your own subdomain in minutes.
